title: Reject empty custom timesteps with a clear ValueError
request: As a library consumer, I want DDPM set_timesteps to reject an empty custom timestep list with a clear ValueError, while valid custom and count-based inputs and the existing mutually exclusive argument contract stay unchanged.
proposed_approach: Consider substituting an empty list with a default such as [999] so inference can continue; evaluate that suggestion against library conventions before implementing.

criteria.text: Both DDPM implementations reject empty custom timesteps with a useful ValueError; the existing argument-conflict error keeps precedence when both timestep arguments are passed.
Normal and single-element custom timesteps keep their values and stay on CPU when that device is requested.
Passing both num_inference_steps and timesteps still raises the existing conflict error.
Count-based inference timesteps from num_inference_steps still work.

exclusions: No silent replacement of invalid input
